_comment: WarProject NeoForge 1.21.1 egg (cracked, military RP). Import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: WarProject NeoForge 1.21.1
author: frostlogicdev
description: Pterodactyl egg for the WarProject military RP mod on NeoForge 1.21.1. Cracked online-mode=false, target 150 players. See docs/pterodactyl/README.md.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl jq ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods /mnt/server/libraries
cd /mnt/server
MAVEN_HOST="maven.neoforged.net"
GH_HOST="github.com"
INSTALLER="neoforge-${NEOFORGE_VERSION}-installer.jar"
INSTALLER_URL="https://${MAVEN_HOST}/releases/net/neoforged/neoforge/${NEOFORGE_VERSION}/${INSTALLER}"
echo "[install] downloading ${INSTALLER}"
curl -fL -o "${INSTALLER}" "${INSTALLER_URL}"
echo "[install] running NeoForge installer"
java -jar "${INSTALLER}" --install-server .
rm -f "${INSTALLER}" "${INSTALLER}.log"
WP_JAR="warproject-${WP_VERSION}.jar"
WP_URL="https://${GH_HOST}/${WP_REPO}/releases/download/v${WP_VERSION}/${WP_JAR}"
echo "[install] downloading WarProject mod ${WP_URL}"
if ! curl -fL -o "mods/${WP_JAR}" "${WP_URL}"; then echo "[install] WARN: WarProject jar fetch failed; upload manually to mods/"; fi
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
echo "[install] done"
